column1: # Tab-separated. Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
#   id  name  version  spdx  binaries  source  copyright  license_files  modifications  notes
# version: a literal version, or ${VAR} resolved from tools/versions.env.
# binaries: semicolon-separated names of shipped executables that contain the
#   component. "mins" is the Go binary itself. Every entry must appear in
# license_files: semicolon-separated paths, relative to the repository root.
#   Every SPDX identifier must have a LICENSES/<identifier>.txt file.
# Keep this file in sync with tools/versions.env. tools/check-licenses.sh
# verifies that every pinned runtime version is referenced here, that every
# shipped tool has a component, and that THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md is current.
